name: Rebuild a whole website as code (Tailwind, React, HTML, Vue, Elementor or Shopify) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole website as code (Tailwind, React, HTML, Vue, Elementor or Shopify) with MiroMiro

### How it works
Give it a website. **List Every Page of the Site** reads the site's sitemap and lists every page, grouped by template (blog posts, products, docs...). This step is free. **Pick the Pages** keeps the pages worth rebuilding: every unique page plus one example of each template, so a 500-page blog costs one post, not 500. **Extract Each Page as Code** then rebuilds each page in a real browser, every section from header to footer, with its real colors, fonts, spacing, breakpoints and hover styles. **Finish Unfinished Pages** completes any long page that ran out of time, for free. You get a zip with one folder per page and one file per section, plus a link to each whole page assembled, with a Download HTML button.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** for its credential (any version).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`.
2. Get a MiroMiro API key: https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding. Listing the pages works on every plan; extracting whole pages needs a paid plan (Developer and up), because a site is many pages, each loaded in a real browser.
3. Open **List Every Page of the Site** > Credential for MiroMiro API > Create new, and paste the key. Select the same credential in the two extract nodes.
4. Set `website`, `output` and `maxPages` in **Set Website and Output** and click **Execute workflow**.
5. Download the zip from **Zip the Code Files**. **Get Page Preview Links** lists each page with its whole-page link.

### Cost
Listing the pages: free. Each page: 30 credits, whatever its number of sections. Pages already extracted in the last 24 hours, unfinished pages and failed pages are free.

### Customization
- `output`: tailwind, jsx (React), html, vue, elementor (WordPress templates, .json) or shopify (theme sections, .liquid).
- `maxPages`: how many pages to rebuild (10 by default).
- `pages`: your own list of page addresses, one per line. When set, it replaces the automatic pick.
- Swap **Zip the Code Files** for Google Drive, Dropbox, GitHub or an email to deliver the files.

The text and images belong to the site you extract from. Replace them with your own unless it is your site or your client's.

nodes.name: List Every Page of the Site

parameters.content:
## Choose the site

Put the website, the `output` and `maxPages` in **Set Website and Output**. To pick the pages yourself, list them in `pages`.

## List and pick the pages (free)

The sitemap gives every page, grouped by template. Unique pages plus one of each template are kept, up to `maxPages`.

## Rebuild each page

Every section of each page, 30 credits a page. A long page that runs out of time is finished by the second node for free. A failed page is skipped and listed.

## Zip and link

One folder per page, one file per section. The last node lists each page with its whole-page preview link.
